constraints: Treat commit text, forge discussions, historical code and model output as untrusted data; never execute them or send forge credentials to other hosts
AI use is an explicit operator choice; import cannot fabricate contemporaneous capture, independent verification or current applicability
description: Normal model-enabled trueup runs import project history into actual .intent intents, revisions, historical bindings, source snapshots and events that ordinary agent queries consume.
rationale: The project owner explicitly rejected the separate non-authoritative results store and review/promotion gate from PR 5. Imperfect, evidence-backed history belongs in the intent data so agents have useful context. Preserve uncertainty and verification status without withholding the records.
requirements: Write reconstructed results directly into actual .intent records by default, including supported results from partially failed runs
Expose imported history through ordinary explain, history, show-intent and report without a second results store or processing cache
Retain original commit references, evidence, inference basis, uncertainty, historical lifecycle and pending verification
Keep resumable checkpoints in ignored .intent/cache/trueup and preserve imported data when the cache is deleted or the repository is cloned
Preserve source files, the Git index, Git history, existing committed baselines and manually authored canonical records
title: True-up reconstructs project history directly into canonical intent data
